levels.name: Technical Compliance
levels.outcome: Projects use required package-native/dashboard-kit contracts and no longer hide old implementation debt.

levels.name: Visual Quality Migration
levels.outcome: Dashboards look and behave like polished products, not just compliant pages.

levels.name: Product-Building OS
levels.outcome: Ideas become product briefs, component maps, workflows, tests, and proof before being called done.

levels.name: Self-Improving Product OS
levels.outcome: Usage, screenshots, failures, and human preference continuously improve products and standards.

levels.name: Company Intelligence Layer
levels.outcome: TLC has memory, decision intelligence, OKR/KPI linkage, risk, finance, and strategy execution visibility.

levels.name: Compound Learning Enterprise
levels.outcome: The company learns, allocates resources, governs humans/agents, and compounds IP over time.
